services.name: Private Events
services.desc: For smaller groups, Heritage Hall can accommodate up to 125 guests indoors or outdoors for a reception, or 70 guests for a formal, seated meal. The General Jackson can accommodate up to 1000 guests, and by chartering her for your group, you can set the tone for your event. From casual to elegant and rock 'n' roll to country, the possibilities are endless. Group rates are available for parties of 20 or more. Whether a group outing, reunion, or private event, the General Jackson Showboat provides the perfect options for a memorable time

services.name: Fall Foliage Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy live music performed by the cast on the open-air Hurricane Deck as you sail upstream, surrounded by vibrant autumn colors. Light food and beverages will be available for purchase, making this a perfect way to relax and take in the crisp fall air. *The timing and vibrancy of fall foliage are subject to natural

services.name: Captain'S Table
services.desc: In addition to the cruise, meal, and show, the Captain’s Table experience includes a table-side greeting and tour of the pilothouse by the captain, upgraded dessert plus a souvenir specialty drink and shirt from the on-board gift

includes: Panoramic views of the Cumberland River and Nashville skyline
blurb: Guests experience a scenic cruise aboard the General Jackson Showboat with live performances of country, bluegrass, and rock 'n' roll music. Cruises include a midday lunch cruise with live entertainment and Southern flavors, and an evening dinner cruise with live music and a Southern-style meal. The boat offers panoramic views of the Cumberland River and the Nashville skyline.
extraNote: Hours vary based on cruise selection · Docked near Opry Mills in Nashville, Tennessee, minutes from Gaylord Opryland, the Grand Ole Opry, and downtown Nashville
